svg.title: Retail electricity prices in data-center states vs the U.S. average

cc:Work.dc:title: Retail electricity prices in data-center states vs the U.S. average
cc:Work.dc:description: Three line charts of real retail prices, 2010 to 2026: Virginia rises faster than the U.S. average since 2021; Texas, Georgia and Arizona are flat or down.
